what_this_is: Founder authorization to write ONE exact composed artifact to ONE production target. Every field under bindings is copied from the verified global deployment manifest and re-checked against the repository by verify_authorization; any disagreement refuses the deploy. Used once: DEPLOYED consumes it.
authorization_source: Operator instruction in session, 2026-09-05, given after being shown the 11-proposed-to-7-promoted reconciliation and the exact reason each of the four pet-friendly rows was withheld: 'Confirmed. Keep all four rows withheld from this deployment. Do not weaken the policy reader and do not infer pet acceptance from a fee. Proceed with PTF-LOUISVILLE-DEPLOYMENT-AUTHORIZATION-003 using the already prepared and reproduced 53-profile Louisville candidate exactly as pinned. No change to the current candidate. Any changed bundle requires new authorization.'
note: The candidate was NOT rebuilt to deploy it. The bundle directory assembled from committed 3363e30 in a clean detached worktree was kept and re-hashed, and it reproduces bundle_sha256 ea9349d31b860504 and sitemap_sha256 08ecce446d9a109e over 4,061 HTML pages and 4,079 files. Production was proved unmoved immediately before this was written: https://pettripfinder.com/sitemap.xml hashes to the live pin's sitemap digest, so deploy 6a9c3a1422ead7c0c01b3468 is still what production serves at 649 profiles. The delta this authorizes is LOUISVILLE ONLY -- 46 to 53 published profiles, 7 routes added and 0 removed, every other market byte-stable. Four pet-friendly rows the revalidation proposed are deliberately EXCLUDED: the committed policy reader withholds pets_allowed on each, and the operator directed that they stay withheld rather than have the reader weakened or acceptance inferred from a fee.
